body:
'back to december' is the one that gets me every time.

it's the rare Taylor song where SHE'S the one apologizing — not the girl who got left, the one who knows she's the one who messed it up. it points straight back to fall 2009 and the romance that started when she met Taylor Lautner on the set of valentine's day.

barely three months together, and it gave us one of her most grown-up songs 😮‍💨

we mapped her whole love story in order — who she was with, when, and the song each chapter left behind. lautner's lands right after the fearless solo stretch.

tap through and read it start to finish 👉 https://longlivets.com/?lens=love-story&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread
